'''"Deathhawk" combat airspeeders''' were combat [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] manufactured by [[Barresin]] and used by the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. They provided support for ground troops and were used to patrol areas of a planet's surface.<ref name="Goroth" />

The "Deathhawk" was crewed by a pilot and co-pilot, the latter of whom controlled the airspeeder's double [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] which had a range of one and a half kilometers. However if necessary a single pilot could control the craft and aim the weaponry by themselves. Imperial forces used "Deathhawk" airspeeders during their occupation of [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth]].<ref name="Goroth" />
